_note: Pinned against kasm-session-runtime's v0.2.2-rc.1 tag (pre-release). This tag makes the two max_tokens reply caps operator config: a max_tokens block (judge, default 2000; tools, default 500) in KASM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_FILE, or KASM_RUNTIME_MAX_TOKENS_JUDGE / KASM_RUNTIME_MAX_TOKENS_TOOLS. Both were hardcoded and sized for the local Gemma deployment; a hosted model hit the tool-call cap. Defaults unchanged, so an unconfigured run sends what it did before; the pair in force is recorded at agent.vision.max_tokens in report.json. The sidebar (pkgs/kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar) is pinned to the same commit -- bump both together. Hashes computed by downloading both published objects (curl) and taking sha256-<base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest>, the same value nix's fixed-output check computes for a fetchurl. Re-pin the same way: download kasm-session-runtime-linux-<amd64|arm64>.<tag>.<short> and kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar.tar.gz.<tag>.<short>, hash, update.
